title: Trough of super typhoon Choi-wan to continue bringing rains in Visayas, Mindanao
summary: The trough or extension of super typhoon Choi-wan outside the Philippine area of responsibility will continue to bring rains over the central and southern Philippines on Monday, PAGASA said.
